text: I. Core Professional OrientationMechanical engineering focuses on core directions such as mechanical design, mechanical manufacturing, mechatronics, and vehicle engineering, covering the entire life cycle from "conception → design → manufacturing → operation → maintenance". It not only involves traditional machinery (such as machine tools and construction machinery), but also deeply integrates with emerging technologies (such as robotics, intelligent manufacturing, and new energy equipment), serving as a key bridge connecting the physical world and the digital world.II. Training ObjectivesTo cultivate high-quality engineering and technical talents with solid mechanical engineering fundamentals, strong engineering practice capabilities, and innovative thinking, who can engage in product design, intelligent manufacturing, equipment research and development, engineering management, and technological innovation in fields such as mechanical manufacturing, automation, aerospace, automotive, and energy.
